answer: Require one paid app-store developer account per identity, $99 a year with ID verification by the store. Each fake needs a fresh paid account and a distinct verified ID, so the cost is $99 plus a real identity per fake. The store's audit is the raven overhead: one banned ID burns every account tied to it, and the crystal rule is that the audit sees every account at once, so the price rises linearly with each fake while the knoll of profit stays far below $99 per identity.
